description: This Python source file defines an IngestionHelper class and related functions for transforming files into Document objects, supporting multiple file formats via dynamic import and class mapping.

classes.name: IngestionHelper
classes.description: Helper class to transform files into a list of Document objects, supporting thread-safe and multiprocessing-safe operations.

methods.name: transform_file_into_documents
methods.description: Transforms a file into a list of Document objects, adding filename metadata and excluding certain metadata keys.

methods.name: _load_file_to_documents
methods.description: Loads a file into Document objects using the appropriate reader based on file extension, defaulting to plain text if no specific reader is found.

methods.name: _exclude_metadata
methods.description: Removes or sets specific metadata keys in Document objects to control what metadata is included in embeddings and LLM contexts.
